notes: This narrow trace covers only the IEEE 1516.1-2025 §11.3.1 prohibition on the RTI sending interactions of FOM-added HLAreport subclasses. The public-API scenario observes one RTI-generated service-report interaction with an added HLAreportServiceInvocation subclass present. It does not cover delivery to subscribers of an added subclass, parent-class promotion, other report classes, or conformance.

requirements.statement: The RTI shall not send interactions of FOM-added subclasses of HLAreport.
